title: Registered foreground focused cargo-test runs stay 'verification received, not settled' while cargo-check runs settle
outcome: A registered focused cargo-test launcher run that passes eligibly on the named root settles its verification onto the launch row the same way a cargo-check run does, or the host says why it stays received and what settles it.
acceptance: Registered foreground focused cargo-test runs stay 'verification received, not settled' while cargo-check runs settle is done
